attacks.name: T-O Talons
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Infection|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| and |§poison§Poison| special conditions.

attacks.name: Buster Cannon
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Shock|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.

attacks.name: Self Must Protect Selffriend
steps: When creating the dice pool for this attack, this character may choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less within |!range| 3 and destroy it. If it does, it may reroll a number of its attack dice up to the destroyed terrain feature's |!size|.
|!wild| |*Throw|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Techno-Organic Absorption
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature within |!range| 3 of |!size| 3 or less and destroy it. Then this character removes |!damage| from itself up to the destroyed terrain feature's |!size|.

superPowers.name: Transmode Virus Infection
superPowers.body: This character and enemy characters within |!range| 2 of this character with the |§poison§Poison| special condition suffer 2 |!damage| in the order of your choosing. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Unstable Outline
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack, if the attacking character is not within |!range| 3 of this character, this character may add 1 die to its defense roll.
